import type { IdentifierContract, LogoData } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export declare class Identifier extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        institutionName: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        logo: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        relationshipText: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        theme: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
    };
    institutionName: string;
    logo: LogoData;
    relationshipText: string;
    theme: IdentifierContract['theme'];
    constructor();
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
